INTRCCUCTION SECTION 1. INTRODUCTION During the Latest Statoil - Troll field gas production tests extremely low production rates were observed. Statoil suspect that swelling clay around the well bore is the prime cause af the low production rate. Statoil have conducted susceptibility tests using formation water and calcium chloride brine.
